info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Careers Applications Referrals-v4-spec
info.description: The Career Applications Referral Listing API enables organizations to retrieve a comprehensive list of referral applications submitted for job openings. This API serves as a vital tool for human resources and recruitment teams, allowing them to efficiently manage and evaluate candidate referrals. By fetching the referral applications, users can streamline their hiring processes and gain insights into candidate sources. Typical consumers include HR professionals, recruitment agencies, and hiring managers looking to enhance their referral programs.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to retrieve a list of referral applications submitted to the system, providing insights into the referral process and application status.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving referral applications. This body is expected to include the necessary parameters required to fetch the relevant referral application data.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the referral data.

ListCareersApplicationsReferralsRequest.description: This schema represents the expected request body in JSON format for the operations related to applications and referrals.

ListCareersApplicationsReferralsResponse.title: Referral Operation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the referral operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the referral.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the referral operation.

state.description: Current state of the referral operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the referral request in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information about the referral operation.

ListCareersApplicationsReferralsResponse.description: Schema representing the response of the referral operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user who created the referral.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the referral was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the referral was created by an automated process.

AuditInfo.description: Schema representing audit information related to the referral operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server spent processing the request. This header provides insights into the performance of the server when handling the operation.
